product.name: ROSENTORP
product.introText: ROSENTORP extendable table 110/155 cm, black. Assembly instructions AA-2407577-1. Two people; work on a soft surface. Tools: hammer, Phillips screwdriver; wrench and Allen keys are included. The integrated butterfly leaf is stored in the frame.
product.partsSummary: 2x Allen key,  2x Arm,  2x Arm dowel,  4x Bracket,  4x Bscrew,  2x Connector,  1x Frame,  24x Fscrew,  4x Leg,  4x Leg barrel,  8x Leg dowel,  4x Leg nut,  4x Leg rod,  4x Leg washer,  1x Pedestal,  2x Pin,  4x Pscrew,  1x Ring,  2x Slide,  2x Top barrel,  2x Top dowel,  2x Top half,  2x Top rod,  1x Wrench

steps.title: Barrel nuts and threaded rods into the legs
steps.text: Lay the 4 legs on a soft surface. Push a barrel nut (104859) into the hole on top of each leg, slot towards the end, and screw a long threaded rod (100041) into the end of the leg until it catches the barrel nut. Use the long rods - the short ones (100037) are for the pedestal top.

steps.title: Dowels into the legs
steps.text: Tap 2 dowels (101367) into the end of each leg with a hammer.

steps.title: Legs onto the pedestal
steps.text: Stand the pedestal upside down. Put the metal ring (10108231) into its bottom end, fit the 4 legs and tighten each rod inside the ring with a washer (100843) and a nut (10103956), using the wrench (128632).

steps.title: Pedestal top
steps.text: Turn the base upright. Push 2 barrel nuts (104859) into the top block of the pedestal and screw the 2 short threaded rods (100037) into the top until they catch.

steps.title: Pedestal top dowels
steps.text: Push 2 dowels (101367) into the top of the pedestal - the long ones, not 101359.

steps.title: Extension slides onto the frame
steps.text: Screw the 2 extension slides (10108610) onto the long rails of the frame with 2 screws (105307) each.

steps.title: Fix the slides
steps.text: Pull the slides out to reach the remaining holes and fix each slide with 4 more screws (105307).

steps.title: Pins and dowels for the support arms
steps.text: Screw a pin (114671) into each end of the frame and push a dowel (101359) into each support arm.

steps.title: Support arms onto the frame
steps.text: Fit the support arms onto the pins at both ends of the frame. Push a cam wheel (114670) into each arm and tighten it with the Allen key (100049).

steps.title: Table top, frame and base
steps.text: Lay the two table top halves face down on a soft surface, push them together and close the 2 latches. Lay the frame onto them, centred in the apron (do not hold it by the support arms), then turn the base over and put the pedestal onto the mounting plate - rods and dowels into the holes, side holes lined up with the slides.

steps.title: Screw the slides to the table top
steps.text: Screw the slides to both halves of the table top with 12 screws (105307).

steps.title: Angle brackets
steps.text: Screw the 4 angle brackets (131375) onto the mounting plate with 4 screws (107624) and toothed washers (100850) - the washer goes under the screw head (see the inset).

steps.title: Brackets to the pedestal
steps.text: Screw the brackets to the pedestal with 4 screws (105307) and toothed washers (100850).

steps.title: Turn the table upright
steps.text: Turn the table the right way up - two people, holding the table top, not the legs.

steps.title: Done - open the latches to extend
steps.text: Open the 2 latches under the table top when you want to extend it: pull the halves apart and unfold the stored leaf (pages 15-19). Close the latches again when the table is closed.
